note: The research module of the OpenZone admin window -- its own pbo and its own layout, because a server without the research mod never loads this file and the core must not know the pane exists. OZL_VppPane.OnCreate builds it under M_SUB_WIDGET and registers it eight times with RegisterPage(research, ...): the rail's pages Overview, Tree, Chains, Point types, Owners, Modules, Statics and Settings all show this one pane, and OnPaneShown switches the page inside it (VPP rework 2026-11-12, design 5.5; the editor itself: docs/specs/2026-11-09-research-editor-vpp-design.md). The shell moves the root into the content area and sizes it (vpp.content by default); the script lays the rest out from that size (OZL_VppPane.RzLayout): the page head, the pages, the problems panel and the draft bar. Lists, the tree canvas and the raw items stretch; forms keep the widths drawn here. Colours are the window's metal (the vpp* tokens) after the reviewed mockup (docs/specs/2026-11-12-openzone-vpp-mockup, Research*.dc.html); script colours come from OZL_Metal. Names the script resolves by string: every widget named Rz*, Res*, Grant*, NodeId and every Btn*; ResHint is resolved by the core from the hint name handed to RegisterPage. Captions are stringtable keys of OpenZone_Research (UA original, EN).

frame.name: PaneResearch
frame.note: Hidden: ShowPane shows the open page's pane and hides the rest. Exact size and place come from the shell.

frame.name: RzRoot
frame.note: Proportional: follows the pane root when the shell resizes it. Everything below is placed by coordinates the script keeps (RzLayout).

frame.name: RzHead
frame.note: The page head: title and one line under it on the left, the page's actions on the right (anchored, so they follow the head's width). One head for all eight pages: the script writes the texts and shows the open page's actions.

frame.name: RzHeadClip
frame.note: Clips the title and the line under it short of the actions; the script sets its width.

button.name: BtnRzHdAct
button.note: The page's one action: refresh on Overview, a new entry on Point types, Owners, Modules and Statics. Hidden on the other pages.

button.name: BtnRzTrDemo
button.note: The preview's state, a select of three: a new faction, a funded one, one with its roots done and a project running. A click steps on; the arrows step either way.

button.name: BtnRzTrView
button.note: Opens the player's own tree window over the admin window with a view built from the draft (OZL_Tree.Fill) and the state picked beside it; ESC comes back.

frame.name: RzPages
frame.note: The pages lie on top of each other at [0, 0]; the script shows the open one and sizes them all.

frame.name: RzPage_overview
frame.note: Factions with their pools on the left, the picked faction's quick actions in the middle (grant, complete a node, reset -- straight to the server, past the draft), what the server reads now on the right.

listbox.name: ResOwners
listbox.note: One row per faction the core's registry or a state file knows.

button.name: BtnReset
button.note: Asks on the window's confirm strip first.

button.name: BtnReload
button.note: Asks on the window's confirm strip first.

text.name: RzSummary
text.note: What the editor holds: how many entries each file of the draft has.

listbox.name: RzOvStList
listbox.note: The static spawner's entries, spawned or waiting, as the server's list answer gives them.

frame.name: RzPage_points
frame.note: Point types (the lines): the list on the left, the picked one's fields on the right. Every field writes the draft as it is typed; the head adds a type, the form deletes the picked one.

frame.name: RzPage_tree
frame.note: The tree of one owner's branch, drawn with that owner's skin the way the player's window draws it (OZL_TreePlan, OZL_TreeLines, the skin's node layout, its price chips and OR labels), from the draft. Owners, branches and the picked branch's form on the left; the canvas in the middle; the picked node's form on the right -- branch and node side by side (design 5.5).

frame.name: RzBrForm
frame.note: The picked branch: always beside the node's form now, not instead of it.

button.name: BtnRzTrLink
button.note: Link mode: click a parent, then children; a click on a child that already has the link takes it away.

raw.name: RzTrScroll
raw.note: The canvas: two-axis scroll, pencil scrollbars as in the player's windows. The script sizes it with the window and RzTrContent with the plan.

raw.name: RzTrLines
raw.note: Grid and links, drawn by OZL_TreeLines with the owner's skin.

frame.name: RzTrNodes
frame.note: One node cell of the skin per node, placed by the plan; each cell's NodeHit is renamed rznode:<id>. The OR labels go here too. A press on the frame itself pans the canvas; a click without a move drops the picked node.

label.name: RzTrInfo
label.note: What a click or a drag does right now: the normal hint, the link mode's next step, the tier a dragged node would land on.

frame.name: RzTrInsp
frame.note: The picked node's fields; with no node picked, a line that says how to pick one.

button.name: BtnRzTnModeAll
button.note: The node's condition as a pair: all parents, or any parent. The script lights the one in force.

label.name: RzTnPrice
label.note: The cost in the lines' own names, as the player reads it.

frame.name: RzPage_chains
frame.note: Processing chains of one owner and one line: the conveyor raw items -> packer -> sample -> analyzer -> carrier -> terminal/pool as six cards; under them the packer's rules (raw items) by the tier of their node with the bulk bar, and the station as the player meets it beside them (stacked under them in a narrow window); the rule's fields on the right. The script fills every text and places the cards and the two panels.

frame.name: RzChPipe
frame.note: Six cards, three in a row; the script places them (one row when the column is wide enough).

frame.name: RzChRawBox
frame.note: The raw items: the packer's rules of the line by the tier of their node, with the bulk bar for a whole tier at the bottom.

panel.name: RzChStation
panel.note: The station as the player meets it, for the rule on the right: always beside the raw items now (design 5.5), not instead of them.

frame.name: RzChInsp
frame.note: The picked rule's fields (RzRuForm), or a note about the terminal and the pool (RzRuInfo).

button.name: BtnRzRuEnabled
button.note: Enabled or not: a click turns the rule on or off.

button.name: BtnRzRuKin
button.note: Which classes the input takes, as a pair: the class and its children, or this class only. The script lights the one in force.

frame.name: RzPage_cfg
frame.note: One page for three files: OWNERS, MODULES and STATICS. The file's entries on the left (the head adds one), the picked entry's fields on the right with its delete. The script names the rows (RzCfgLbl0..7), hides the unused ones and writes the hints; OWNERS adds the tree window picker, MODULES a line of what the module does, STATICS the button that takes the admin's place.

button.name: BtnRzCfgAct
button.note: The page's own action, named by the script: on STATICS it takes the admin's position and heading.

frame.name: RzCfgSkins
frame.note: OWNERS: the tree window picked from the seven skins (design 5.5), or by the faction's id. The script names the buttons and lights the one in force.

label.name: RzCfgFacts
label.note: MODULES: what the picked module does to its line's sample.

frame.name: RzPage_settings
frame.note: Settings for every faction, by the source of factions (design 5.5): the core says who gives the factions (Ask config identity) and what that source knows; post fields the source does not know are dimmed with what holds instead. Artboards ResearchSettings and ResearchSettingsFfr are this page in two states.

panel.name: RzSeWhoEdge
panel.note: The accent frame of the who-spends callout: the panel under RzSeWhoBox, one unit larger on every side.

panel.name: RzProbs
panel.note: What the server's own checks will say about the draft (Validate and Check of the seven files): a panel above the draft bar, opened by its problems button, over every page of the module (design 5.5). The pages above it get shorter while it is open.

panel.name: RzBar
panel.note: The draft: its state on the left, the problems button, the last line for the admin (ResHint), then undo, redo, discard and apply anchored to the right. The script writes the counts and the colours.
